blocks.html:
Utilize a Partial Wrap to Grow Your Business!

We all know that wraps are a great way to increase brand visibility, but did you know they can also help your business grow?

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’ve seen it over and over again: businesses that take advantage of the vinyl wrap craze are able to expand their customer base and attract new customers. And one of the best ways to do this is by using a partial wrap on your vehicle.

That’s where Canada Profi Lubricants Inc comes in. They needed a way to get their message out while still being able to use their van for work, so we suggested a partial wrap on their Mercedes Sprinter. Our team of graphic designers used a wide range of vinyl colours from Avery Dennison, and we worked with them to create a design that would be eye-catching and memorable—but also professional enough for their needs.

Our installers were also able to take care of all the installation work for them, so they could focus on running their company instead of worrying about how their vehicle was going to look when it was done!

If you would like to personalize your car, truck, boat, or other personal items – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next partial wrap with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
